title: From idea to prototype with Claude Design
summary: Take one idea from a brainstorm to a design brief in a new prototype folder, prepare its docs/design folder, design and hand it over in Claude Design, save and sync the result, implement the ready screens in the prototype and plan it into the next release candidate.
audience: Product people, designers and developers who want to turn an idea into an implemented prototype with this repository's tools

steps.title: Understand the journey
steps.goal: Know the stages from idea to release candidate, the terms they use and every file you will touch.

checklist.label: I know the eight stages of the journey
I read where to find what

actions.label: See the project's configuration and next step

steps.title: Name your prototype
steps.goal: Choose the prototype title, its folder slug and the release candidate version that later steps check against.
steps.markdown:
Choose three names now; later steps check your files under exactly these names.

- **Title**: the prototype title you will type in the prototype maker, for example `Reading log`.
- **Slug**: the folder name of the prototype package and the design folder, for example `reading-log`. Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 48 characters. The design-folder question derives its folder from the title, so pick the slug the title produces (`Reading log` → `reading-log`).
- **Version**: the next release candidate, `x.y.z`, for example `0.5.0`.

Your files will be `prototypes/<slug>/`, `docs/design/<slug>/` and `docs/releases/candidates/<version>/`. See [[docs/development/CLAUDE-DESIGN-HANDOFF#Commands|the --name rules]].

winConditions.label: You chose a release candidate version

steps.title: Brainstorm the idea
steps.goal: Write down the problem, users, options, risks and non-goals of your idea before designing anything.

choices.label: With Claude Code (ideation-brainstorm skill, PRD in docs/prds)
With node bin/app brainstorm (feature package in brainstorms/)

fields.label: Project-relative file that records the result (e.g. docs/prds/reading-log.md)

actions.label: Brainstorm a feature of the saved project
Saved project and base hash a feature brainstorm needs
Plan a feature package from a request
actions.command: node bin/app brainstorm feature --input feature.json --out brainstorms/<slug> --json

steps.title: Write the design brief in a new prototype folder
steps.goal: Turn the brainstorm into an agreed design brief and a prototype package in prototypes/<slug>.

checklist.label: I reviewed the brief's defaults before agreeing
I entered prototypes/<slug> as the package output folder

steps.title: Create the docs/design folder
steps.goal: Answer the design-folder question and prepare docs/design/<slug> for Claude Design through a reviewed plan.

actions.label: Plan the design folder (then repeat with --apply <planHash>)
actions.command: node bin/app design prepare --name <slug> --project prototypes/<slug>/companion.project.json --package prototypes/<slug> --json

winConditions.label: docs/design/{{plan.slug}} is a prepared design folder
The folder keeps your design brief

steps.title: Open the folder in Claude Design and design
steps.goal: Import docs/design/<slug> into Claude Design and build interactive prototypes from its screens.

checklist.label: design status reported the folder as current before I imported it
I imported docs/design/<slug> into Claude Design
I asked Claude Design to read AGENTS.md first
Claude Design built an interactive prototype for at least one screen

steps.title: Ask Claude Design for the handover files
steps.goal: Have Claude Design produce the prototypes, decisions and implementation-map rows that the generated handoff documents require.

checklist.label: I asked Claude Design to prepare the handover as ENGINEERING_HANDOFF_GUIDE.md and AGENTS.md describe
Each finished screen is a prototypes/<screen-id>--<variant>.html file with data-design-id attributes
New tokens, components, business rules and open questions are in notes/decisions.md
Finished rows of handoff/implementation-map.md list their files and acceptance notes and say ready

steps.title: Save the design into docs/design and sync
steps.goal: Export the design work into docs/design/<slug>, check it with design status and keep the generated files current with design sync.

fields.label: One prototype file you saved in prototypes/ (e.g. node-1--compact.html)

winConditions.label: The prototype maps its elements with data-design-id
At least one implementation-map row is ready

steps.title: Implement the ready screens in the prototype
steps.goal: Have Claude Code build the ready rows in the prototype package, following HANDOFF.md and the execution prompt, and record them as implemented.

checklist.label: I gave Claude Code the implementation request with HANDOFF.md and execution-prompt.md
Screens, components or interactions the design added went into the project model first, then design sync
The gates ran with real output (at least node bin/app check)

winConditions.label: At least one implementation-map row is implemented

steps.title: Record a release item
steps.goal: Record the implemented prototype as a release item whose sources point at the prototype package and the design folder.

fields.label: Release item note file in docs/releases/items (e.g. ITEM-0001-reading-log.md)

winConditions.label: Your release item note has type: ReleaseItem
Your release item note has the id {{release.itemId}}

steps.title: Add it to the next release candidate
steps.goal: Plan the release item into the release candidate for the version you chose.
